dedupe_keys.name: data for research and application of bag filter system for railway ballast bed coal suction vehicles

description: Ke Lu publishes supporting measurements and figures for improving the bag-filter system of railway ballast-bed coal suction vehicles. Zenodo mirrors the Dryad release and provides five figure documents and two table documents in DOCX, free under CC0. The README maps them to air velocity, airflow and resistance, cleaning-pulse settings, dust-removal efficiency and dust mass concentration. These results can benchmark airflow and dust-collection simulations for tunnel maintenance equipment. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this test unit. Coverage is one experimental apparatus and associated field application; the inspection does not establish tunnel location, sampling dates or full measurement uncertainty. Published performance values are author results, not independently checked guarantees. Figures may require extraction before numerical comparison, and no executable CFD configuration is identified. Documents were not downloaded and no dust-removal calculation was reproduced.
